query: SELECT reasoning_depth, generator_model, uses_knowledge_graph FROM cspaper WHERE uses_knowledge_graph = 'No' AND topic = 'SFT' AND reasoning_depth != 'multi-hop' AND baseline != 'LLaMa3.1-8b; Qwen2.5-7b; Longcite; RAG-Ex';
note: SQL本身只有结构化算子；SExtract是从原文到关系的分析性补充，不是源SQL的显式调用，也不表明每个字段必须由LLM抽取。字段类型、NULL及一对多抽取契约须在执行前固定。

nodes.detail: uses_knowledge_graph = 'No' AND topic = 'SFT' AND reasoning_depth <> 'multi-hop' AND baseline <> 'LLaMa3.1-8b; Qwen2.5-7b; Longcite; RAG-Ex'
